games.title: Solitaire
games.description: Five ways to clear a deck, from Klondike to TriPeaks.

games.title: Mahjong
games.description: Match pairs of free tiles and clear layered boards.

games.title: Minesweeper
games.description: Read the number clues and uncover the safe squares.

games.title: Sudoku
games.description: Fill the grid one deduction at a time.

games.title: Jigsaw
games.description: Piece together landscapes, illustrations, and photographs.

games.title: Word Games
games.description: Find hidden words, rearrange letter tiles, or solve a crossword.

games.title: Match Three
games.description: Line up gems and set off chains across the board.

games.title: Bubble Shooter
games.description: Bank shots off the walls and clear clusters of bubbles.

games.title: Mine Trails
games.description: Follow number clues through a network of underground rooms.

games.title: Block Puzzle
games.description: Fit shapes into the grid and make space for the next piece.

games.title: Gem Cascade
games.description: Drop gems into place and plan a chain reaction.

games.title: Mahjong Cubes
games.description: Turn a stack of cubes to uncover matching pairs.

games.title: Reversi
games.description: Surround your opponent’s discs and turn the board in your favor.

games.title: Checkers
games.description: Jump opposing pieces and crown kings on a carved wooden board.

games.title: Hearts
games.description: Play a four-player trick-taking game and keep penalty cards out of your pile.

games.title: Picture Logic
games.description: Follow numbered row and column clues to uncover a hidden picture.

games.title: Memory Match
games.description: Turn over illustrated tidepool cards and find each matching pair.

games.title: Kakuro
games.description: Fill crossing runs of digits so they add up to the clues.

games.title: Dominoes
games.description: Match pips at either end of the chain and empty your hand.

games.title: Chess
games.description: Play a match against a friend or an offline computer opponent.

games.title: Peg Solitaire
games.description: Jump pegs on an enamel cross board and aim to leave one in the brass center.

solitaire_modes.title: Klondike
solitaire_modes.description: Build four foundations, starting with the aces.

solitaire_modes.title: Spider
solitaire_modes.description: Build complete runs in the same suit to clear the tableau.

solitaire_modes.title: FreeCell
solitaire_modes.description: Use four temporary cells to move cards into their foundations.

solitaire_modes.title: Pyramid
solitaire_modes.description: Clear the layout by removing pairs that add up to thirteen.

solitaire_modes.title: TriPeaks
solitaire_modes.description: Clear three peaks by picking cards one rank higher or lower.
